patterns.about: An ngrok authtoken by shape: <27 alphanumerics>_<21+ alphanumerics>, starting with a digit

The one-time token in a reset or device-login link: the API's /auth/reset/{token}, and the page's /reset/{token} at the start of a path or after a host — never a route that merely has a device segment, like /oauth/github/device/start
